notes: All ten text files are Common Crawl captures; sourceUrl is the index lookup address from each footer and sourceDate is the capture timestamp date. Columbia Business School "Dissertations" pages (year=2016, 2017, 2018): each entry reads "Name, YEAR" with a Faculty Advisor line and abstract; the page does not say whether the year is the defense, deposit or graduation year, so yearMeaning is "unstated". The division (Accounting, DRO, Finance, Management, Marketing) and the degree are not written per person; program and degree are null. The lists span all divisions, not only operations. Columbia year=2016: the 2017-10-17 capture lists 9 people with no pagination; the 2019-10-22 capture lists 10 people and shows "1 of 3 / Older items", so the full 2016 list is longer than either capture (Cinar Kilcioglu, Davide Crapis, Eric Anicich, Colleen Honigsberg, Arpit Gupta appear only in 2019; Charles Raphael Daniel Guetta, John Jia-Hao Yao, Guojun Chen, Yunru Han appear only in 2017). Columbia year=2017: the 2019-10-22 capture contains two entries for the same dissertation, "Pably Slutzky" and "Paolo Slutzky" (both advisor Charles Calomiris); both are recorded as written. The 2018 capture has "Pably Slutzky" with an empty Faculty Advisor field. Names and advisors are copied with the page's typos ("Ciamac Malllemi", "Suresh Sundarsan", "DOngwook Shin", "Carri Chen"). "Yena Stephanie Kim ", "Pably Slutzky " and "Colleen Honigsberg " have trailing spaces on the page before the comma; trimmed here. ERIM "On the Job Market" (2017-10-17): six PhD candidates expected to finish within 12 months; no year and no placement given, listedYear null, yearMeaning "job-market". Only page 1 of at least 4 was captured. Promotors are kept in note only. ERIM Erasmus Center for Optimization in Public Transport "PhD Theses": 14 theses in the 2017 capture, 15 in the 2018 capture (P.C. Bouman, 2017, added). Names are initials plus surname. The year is the thesis year in parentheses (yearMeaning "unstated"). L.G. Kroon (1990 thesis) is listed as a thesis author and is recorded as such although he is also a (deceased) promotor elsewhere on the site. These are Erasmus University Rotterdam theses associated with the center; the page does not name a department. Georgia Tech ACO "ACO Dissertations": the table (Date of Defense | Title | Author | Advisor) is identical in both captures (81 rows each; only the 2018 navigation adds an "Ombudsman" link). Year is taken from the defense date; yearMeaning "unstated". Names are kept surname-first as printed ("Agarwal, Richa"; "Saberi Amin" without a comma; "de Farias, Ismael, Jr."). The row for "Gopalakrishnan, Balaji" (August 2, 2002) has an empty title cell. "Calinescu, Gruia" has only a month and year ("December 1998"). ACO is an interdisciplinary doctoral program spanning ISyE, Math and CS; many authors are not operations researchers.
